subject: Medford High School Safety Plan
overview: The Medford School Committee met to address school climate and security following a recent stabbing at Medford High School, reviewing a 10-point safety plan and approving a consultant contract with retired superintendent Michael Welch. The committee also voted to prepare a resubmission to the Massachusetts School Building Authority core project program and approved a resolution establishing protocols for student incident reporting.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda covering bills, payrolls, and meeting minutes from December 19, 2022.

items.title: Rules and Policy Subcommittee Minutes
items.summary: Tabled the minutes from the December 6, 2022 Rules and Policy Subcommittee meeting.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reported on community behavioral health helplines and previewed upcoming district events.

items.title: World Language Program Update
items.summary: World Language Coordinator Vilma Bibeau presented curriculum updates, national standards alignment, and online course evaluations.

items.title: Medford High School Safety Plan
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent presented a 10-point safety plan addressing bathroom occupancy limits, student IDs, hallway monitoring, and an anonymous tip line, with the committee voting to receive an update on February 27.

items.title: District Consultant Contract
items.summary: Approved an amended $25,500 contract engaging retired superintendent Michael Welch to review school culture, climate, and safety practices through February 2023.

items.title: MSBA Status and FY23 Budget Update
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent David Murphy reported on the district's MSBA application status and mid-year budget projections, prompting approved motions to prepare a core program resubmission in April and develop a plan to fix high school internet connectivity.

items.title: Resolution on Student Incident Reports
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requiring the administration to develop and present an initial student incident reporting form and notification protocol by January 23.

items.title: Public Comment on High School Climate
items.summary: Under a suspension of the rules, residents shared concerns regarding ongoing student behavior, enforcement of discipline, and previous experiences with school bullying.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: Read condolences for four former employees and community members followed by a moment of silence.
